unemployment_rate.label: Unemployment rate
unemployment_rate.note: Share of the labor force without a job and looking for one. People are counted where they live, not where they work. County figures come from a BLS model, not a direct count.

labor_force.label: Labor force
labor_force.note: Residents 16 and older who have a job or are looking for one. People are counted where they live, not where they work. County figures come from a BLS model, not a direct count.

employed.label: Employed residents
employed.note: Residents who had a job, wherever the job is. People are counted where they live, not where they work. County figures come from a BLS model, not a direct count.

labor_force_change_pct.label: Change in labor force since 2019
labor_force_change_pct.note: Percent change in the labor force from the 2019 annual average. Each series point is that year's change from 2019. People are counted where they live, not where they work. County figures come from a BLS model, not a direct count.

private_jobs.source: BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages
private_jobs.label: Private-sector jobs
private_jobs.note: Average number of private-sector jobs in the county during the year. Jobs are counted where the job is, not where the worker lives. Covers jobs under state unemployment insurance.

avg_weekly_wage.source: BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages
avg_weekly_wage.label: Average weekly wage
avg_weekly_wage.note: Average weekly pay per job, all employers including government. Dollars are not adjusted for inflation. Jobs are counted where the job is, not where the worker lives. Covers jobs under state unemployment insurance.

manufacturing_share.source: BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages
manufacturing_share.label: Manufacturing share of private jobs
manufacturing_share.note: Private manufacturing jobs (NAICS 31-33) as a share of private jobs. Blank where BLS withholds the figure to protect employer privacy.

health_care_share.source: BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages
health_care_share.label: Health care share of private jobs
health_care_share.note: Private health care and social assistance jobs (NAICS 62) as a share of private jobs. Blank where BLS withholds the figure.

top_industry_share.source: BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages
top_industry_share.label: Largest industry's share of private jobs
top_industry_share.note: Share of private jobs in the county's single largest industry (3-digit NAICS) among industries BLS discloses. Withheld industries could be larger; the flag shows when more than 20% of private jobs sit in withheld industries.

concentration_hhi.source: BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages
concentration_hhi.label: Job concentration index
concentration_hhi.note: Herfindahl index of private jobs across the 11 NAICS supersectors, 0 to 10,000; higher means jobs depend on fewer sectors. Computed on disclosed sectors only, so it reads low where sectors are withheld.
